title: Infinite scroll on a Total Qty sort shows every part once, untracked at the end
custom_preconds:
• A location with more than one page of parts (over 30) and some untracked parts.
  • Parts > Inventory, Active tab, no search.
custom_steps:
1. Sort Total Qty ascending.
  2. Scroll to the end so every page loads.
  3. Sort Total Qty descending and scroll to the end again.
custom_expected:
Step 2:

  • Tracked parts by quantity, lowest first (negative stock first).
  • The untracked parts are the last rows, A–Z.
  • No part appears twice and none is missing compared with the row count.

Step 3:

  • Highest first; untracked still last A–Z; no duplicates or gaps.
